assets.author: 32kda
assets.provenance: new web search and download in this study
assets.free_scope: Full warehouse model, three diffuse skins, Blender and Godot source; not a paid teaser.
assets.modifications: Uniform scale 0.95 for principal buildings, original UVs retained; muted albedo tint. Imported mesh and transform extracted into editable native scene. Main source mesh includes pronounced buttresses and eaves. Round 02 shader reduces saturation to 0.38 and contrast to 0.47 while retaining original UV and texture sampling; darkened foot course.

assets.author: Trey Ramm / minime453
assets.provenance: new web search and download in this study
assets.free_scope: 157 FBX meshes and gradient atlas, full archive.
assets.modifications: Selected window-frame and stair meshes, atlas assigned, colors muted. EFrame is tall multi-module frame, uniformly scaled 0.5 to fit existing facade. Round 02 adds an 8m by 6m rear pumping-office tower using four 3m storeys plus a local raised east service bay from measured 2m wall/window and roof modules, with a simple atlas-aware plaster/metal treatment.

assets.author: Ron Kapaun / 3TD Studios, distributed by hreikin
assets.provenance: new web search and download in this study
assets.free_scope: Two barrels, crate, pallet, road barrier, safety cone, gas container and supplied textures.
assets.modifications: Discarded embedded lower LOD and collision display meshes; manually assigned original diffuse maps because Collada materials did not import references. No archive scripts executed. Lowered saturation through final lighting; spec maps not incorrectly treated as metallic.
